name: Faun-Ardèche Classic
story: Faun-Ardèche Classic 2026 was blown apart on the final climbs after an early breakaway was kept under control and never gained much room. The decisive move came with around 45 kilometres to go. Whilst Jorgenson was able to hold on initially, Seixas went clear after pulling for a while. In the valley Seixas kept extending his lead over a chase group featuring Christen, Martinez and Jorgenson. The chasers could not organise an effective response and were left fighting for the podium. Seixas soloed to the victory, with Christen taking second and Martinez edging Jorgenson for third.
